question: Can a fresh task-owned AudioQueue reproduce the known first-start gain signature, and does an explicit unity assignment before first start change the complete reference result?
scope: Original synthetic canonical 44100 Hz stereo 24-bit fixture decoded to exact Float32; no Spotify or Music playback, no subscription material.

plannedRuns.variable: Never set AudioQueue volume; inspect public default readback.
Set volume to exactly 1 once before first Start; inspect return status and readback.

commonSetup: New child and queue for each run.
Explicit BlackHole CurrentDevice; matching 44100 Hz interleaved stereo Float32.
No AudioQueuePrime, AudioQueueStart, separate zero source or source prerender before the parent tap is armed.
Bounded wait for a CoreAudio AudioProcess object after queue creation; if unavailable, stop without substituting prewarm.
Only after capture is armed does GO cause the first AudioQueueStart.
The unchanged reference begins at the first source frame; zeros may follow it for postroll.
One continuous exclusive WALKMAN output capture; exact full-reference comparator and bounded rejection diagnostics; no gain fitting in acceptance.
Record enqueue/completion without claiming a returned buffer independently proves rendering.
Stop task-owned audio, confirm disposal, and restore only lease-owned state after each run.
readbacks: Queue volume and volume ramp time before optional assignment.
Queue volume and ramp time after optional assignment.
CurrentDevice matches intended BlackHole UID locally; avoid publishing private unrelated device identities.
decisionRules: If an unstarted queue lacks a HAL process, both attempted variants are blocked as first-start measurements; do not call no capture a pass.
If either exact known onset is captured, compare all retained raw words with the existing model without refitting.
If only one assignment variant changes the outcome, run the same two cases in reverse order once to test order sensitivity before attributing the effect.

If both references pass completely, conclude only that this fresh AudioQueue configuration did not reproduce the Spotify signature; do not attribute the signature to Spotify or exclude shared macOS processing.
If failures are buffer/timestamp/registration faults, classify the setup failure separately from sample modification.
No general reliability or receiver claim follows from this bounded pair.
baseline: Read-only work/audioqueue-before-{devices,formats,clock,levels}.json; current external default retained; WALKMAN 192000 Hz and BlackHole 44100 Hz, scalar0.5, mute0.
softwareChange: Experimental helper under work only; production unchanged.

prerequisiteAmendment.reason: Public SDK documents TapAutoStart waiting for first tapped audio, so full capture may have a circular first-start dependency. Establish unstarted process visibility first.
prerequisiteAmendment.phase: Standalone registration-only, no Start or Prime, no tap or aggregate, no default-route or device-rate write, no DAC ownership.
prerequisiteAmendment.observations: Own-process PID translation and running-output state before NewOutput and after each preparation stage; AudioQueue parameters and IsRunning; disposal status.
prerequisiteAmendment.interpretation: Registration is not proof of a tap-usable stream or successful full-reference capture; no playback verdict from this phase.
prerequisiteAmendment.fullPlaybackStatus: Deferred pending prerequisite evidence and a bounded capture-start design.

captureAmendment.prerequisiteResult: Both preparation probes succeeded, with a matching non-running process already visible in the pre-NewOutput observation; volume1/ramp0; no queue playback or callbacks; all state snapshots unchanged.
captureAmendment.experimentalSourceChange: Scratch copy of current FiloCore with only kAudioAggregateDeviceTapAutoStartKey set false instead of true; production source stays unchanged.
captureAmendment.reason: Allow the aggregate capture to start before the source receives its first GO, avoiding documented wait-for-first-audio dependency.
captureAmendment.inferenceLimit: This tests a configured public AudioQueue plus experimental no-wait tap path. It is not a reproduction of the exact production Spotify topology and cannot identify the component responsible for Spotify onset.
captureAmendment.captureDesign: Full original known reference in one first AudioQueueStart, no explicit Prime or prior silent renderer. Raw physical callback comparison plus existing bounded rejection diagnostics.
captureAmendment.externalWatchdog: Each task-owned parent/child process group gets a 45-second limit; TERM then bounded KILL only on timeout; verify receipts, child exit and conditional journal recovery before another run.
